translations.web: The high priest stood up in the middle, and asked Jesus, “Have you no answer? What is it which these testify against you?”
translations.bsb: So the high priest stood up before them and questioned Jesus, “Have You no answer? What are these men testifying against You?”
translations.kjv: And the high priest stood up in the midst, and asked Jesus, saying, Answerest thou nothing? what is it which these witness against thee?
